title: Billing · duplicate payment
state: The customer paid twice for one order and asks for the duplicate payment to be refunded. The service still works. There is no deadline today.

question_1.instructions: Which team should handle this request?

question_2.instructions: Does the customer ask for a refund?

criteria: Low: no deadline or blocked service
High: blocked service or a deadline today

title: IT support · login failure
state: An employee cannot sign in because the application shows a server error. The employee needs technical assistance. There is no payment problem.

question_1.instructions: Which team should handle this issue?

criteria.A: IT support — login and application errors

question_2.instructions: Can the employee sign in successfully?

title: Purchasing · supplier quote
state: A buyer received a supplier quote: one item costs 40.00 and another costs 60.00. The quote states a total of 100.00. The buyer needs the purchasing team to review it.

question_1.instructions: Which team should review the quote?

question_2.instructions: Does the quote state a total of 100.00?

title: Expenses · missing receipt
state: An employee requests reimbursement for a taxi trip. Company policy requires a receipt. No receipt was attached.

question_1.instructions: What should the reviewer do next?

criteria.C: Send the case to technical support

title: Inventory · empty stock
state: Warehouse records and a physical count both show zero units of item P-10. A customer needs one unit. Company policy requires a replenishment request when confirmed stock is zero.

question_1.instructions: What is the appropriate next step?

criteria.B: Confirm that the item is available now
criteria.C: Close the request as a software incident

question_2.instructions: Is one unit available in stock?

title: Sales · product demo
state: A prospective customer asks to schedule a demonstration of our product. They are not reporting a technical fault or a billing problem.

question_1.instructions: Which team should handle the request?

question_2.instructions: Did the customer request a product demonstration?

title: Documents · unsigned contract
state: A contract is ready for review, but the customer signature field is empty. A signed contract is required before proceeding.

criteria.B: Proceed as if the contract were signed

question_2.instructions: Has the customer signed the contract?

title: Logistics · delayed delivery
state: A customer reports that a parcel has not arrived. Tracking says the delivery is delayed. The customer wants the delivery status checked.

question_1.instructions: Which team should handle this request?

question_2.instructions: Has the parcel arrived according to these facts?

title: Review · missing details
state: The only message is: Please help me. No issue, order, payment or technical problem is described.

question_1.instructions: Which team should receive this case?

question_2.instructions: Does the message describe a specific problem?

title: RPG · attack with an available skill
state: A short RPG fight: turn 1, the player approaches; turn 2, the monster blocks; turn 3, it is the monster turn. The monster has 60/80 HP and zero mana. The enemy player is 1 meter away. Claw is ready, costs zero mana and reaches 2 meters. Frost Snare costs 10 mana. Heal costs 20 mana. The retreat path is blocked. Game policy: use an available attack when healthy and unable to retreat.

question_1.instructions: Which action is available and follows the game policy?

criteria.A: Attack the nearby player with Claw
criteria.B: Use Frost Snare without the required mana
criteria.C: Use Heal without the required mana

question_2.instructions: Does the monster have enough mana to use Heal?

title: Security · altered checkout request
state: Fictional defensive review. The trusted server record requires payment of 49.90. The received request changes the amount to 0.01, changes the action to refund and adds role=admin. The client cannot grant itself an admin role. Server policy requires rejecting execution whenever the received amount or action differs from the trusted record. No website request is executed.

question_1.instructions: How should the server handle this altered request?

criteria.A: Reject execution and investigate the mismatch
criteria.B: Execute the modified request without checks
criteria.C: Trust the admin role supplied by the client

question_2.instructions: Did the client change the payment amount?
